title: Green Prescribing and Nature benefits for Mental Health – with Dan Loveard

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你的专业知识即使在你没工作时也能为你赚钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and since 2019 I've been building additional income streams
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在建立额外的收入来源，

sentences.en: through books, online courses and memberships, and it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 通过书籍、在线课程和会员制，这给我的事业和生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7pm, Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you can turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚 7 点，Sophie Foote 将举办一场免费的“在线赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士能加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也会参加，支持一个由心理学家同行组成的可爱社区，探索一对一工作之外的可能性。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，可以观看回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place, because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom too.
sentences.zh: 点击此片头视频中的链接，或在社交媒体上联系我获取免费名额，因为你既可以服务他人，也理应获得财务自由。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: We can be pretty good in the mental health industry at trying to polish up the dull side of a penny and finding advantages.
sentences.zh: 在心理健康行业，我们很擅长试图把硬币暗淡的一面擦亮，并从中寻找优势。

sentences.en: And certainly one of the advantages I found about the lockdowns was how much more immersed in nature I was able to be.
sentences.zh: 我发现封锁期间的一个优势确实是让我能够更多地沉浸在大自然中。

sentences.en: So it gave me time to slow everything down.
sentences.zh: 它给了我放慢一切节奏的时间。

sentences.en: And I was going out for more walks and I even started running.
sentences.zh: 我开始更多地外出散步，甚至开始跑步了。

sentences.en: So being able to see, you know, spring emerging and, you know, making way for summer, making way for autumn and then winter as well and seeing the change in the seasons,
sentences.zh: 所以能够看到，你知道，春天萌发，为夏天让路，再为秋天和冬天让路，看到季节的更替，

sentences.en: for me felt like a really nice opportunity.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，感觉是一个非常好的机会。

sentences.en: And people during lockdown found new ways to welcome kind of nature and wildlife into their daily lives and into their well-being too, and into their schedules too.
sentences.zh: 在封锁期间，人们也找到了将自然和野生动物融入日常生活、健康状况以及日程安排中的新方式。

sentences.en: I made contact with somebody who is a nature wildlife specialist,
sentences.zh: 我联系了一位自然野生动物专家，

sentences.en: because I thought it'd be really nice for us to learn a bit about the benefits of being out and about in the outdoors,
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得让我们了解一下户外活动的好处会非常棒，

sentences.en: but also thinking about the benefits we can highlight to our clients through something called green prescribing.
sentences.zh: 同时也思考一下我们可以通过所谓的“绿色处方”向客户强调哪些益处。

sentences.en: We are all human.
sentences.zh: 我们都是凡人。

sentences.en: And my guest contacted me after we'd recorded this to say that he had accidentally got spring watch and autumn watch muddled up.
sentences.zh: 我的嘉宾在录制完这期节目后联系我，说他不小心把《春日观察》和《秋日观察》搞混了。

sentences.en: So it isn't spring watch that's going to be potentially discontinued.
sentences.zh: 所以，可能面临停播的并不是《春日观察》。

sentences.en: It's autumn watch.
sentences.zh: 而是《秋日观察》。

sentences.en: So when you get to that bit, if you're watching on YouTube, it will pop up on the screen to explain the mix up.
sentences.zh: 所以当你看到那部分时，如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，屏幕上会弹出说明来解释这个混淆。

sentences.en: But if you get to that bit and you're listening on the podcast, then, yeah, we mean the other way around.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是在听播客，那么，是的，我们指的是反过来的情况。

sentences.en: So it's not spring watch that's potentially stopping.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是《春日观察》可能要停播。

sentences.en: It is autumn watch.
sentences.zh: 而是《秋日观察》。

sentences.en: So I hope that clears up any confusion.
sentences.zh: 希望这能消除任何困惑。

sentences.en: I have also been notified that you can actually do reviews and ratings on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我还收到通知说，你其实可以在 Spotify 上进行评分和评论。

sentences.en: So I know most of you do listen on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们大多数人都是在 Spotify 上收听的。

sentences.en: That is our most popular streaming platform.
sentences.zh: 那是我们最受欢迎的流媒体平台。

sentences.en: So if you indeed are listening on Spotify, please do take a moment to rate and review the show.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你确实是在 Spotify 上收听，请花点时间为节目评分和评论。

sentences.en: So I don't use Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我不使用 Spotify。

sentences.en: I haven't got Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我没有 Spotify。

sentences.en: So I don't know how to talk you through that process.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道该如何指导你完成那个过程。

sentences.en: But if you do use Spotify, do have a little look and let me know.
sentences.zh: 但如果你确实使用 Spotify，请看一看并告诉我。

sentences.en: Maybe send me some screenshots of how you do it so I can explain it to other people.
sentences.zh: 也许可以给我发一些操作截图，这样我就可以向其他人解释了。

sentences.en: That would be so wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那会非常棒。

sentences.en: So I hope you find today's episode really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得今天的节目很有用。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a little bit different today, but I think it's really useful to give you a breadth of things that are useful to you
sentences.zh: 是的，今天的内容有点不同，但我认为提供一些对你有用的广泛知识是非常有意义的，

sentences.en: as an aspiring psychologist and a mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 作为一名有抱负的心理学家和心理健康专业人士。

sentences.en: So if you find it useful, I'll catch up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有用，我们稍后再见。

sentences.en: So welcome to my guest today, Dan Lovard.
sentences.zh: 欢迎今天的嘉宾 Dan Lovard。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Marion.
sentences.zh: 你好，Marian。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm really well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for asking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的关心。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm good, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: So I'm on your mailing list for where you work, which is how I heard about you and your work.
sentences.zh: 我订阅了你工作单位的邮件列表，这就是我听说你和你工作的原因。

sentences.en: And I was intrigued to learn a little bit more and to help our audience learn a little bit more about wildlife and being out in nature
sentences.zh: 我很想多了解一些，并帮助我们的听众更多地了解野生动物和置身于大自然中，

sentences.en: and how that can be really beneficial for our mental health if we are working in mental health and also for our clients that we work with as well.
sentences.zh: 以及如果我们从事心理健康工作，这如何对我们的心理健康非常有益，同时也对我们服务的客户有益。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm happy to talk more about what we offer at Warwickshire Wildlife TruSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很乐意多谈谈我们在沃里克郡野生动物信托基金（Warwickshire Wildlife Trust）提供的服务。

sentences.en: So we have a health and wellbeing team and they deliver a variety of different opportunities for people to be inspired and engage in nature activities.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个健康与福祉团队，他们为人们提供各种各样的机会，让他们受到启发并参与自然活动。

sentences.en: So we run wellbeing courses, which are in line with the five ways to wellbeing, which you might be aware of.
sentences.zh: 我们开展福祉课程，这些课程符合“福祉五法”，你可能听说过。

sentences.en: They're the nationally recognised approaches, if you like, that the NHS came up with.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，它们是英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）提出的全国公认的方法。

sentences.en: And we've put that in a nature context, which has worked really well and we've received so much positive feedback and stories from them being a part of those courses.
sentences.zh: 我们将其置于自然背景下，效果非常好，我们收到了很多积极的反馈，以及参与这些课程的人们的故事。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I can delve into a little bit more about those courses.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我可以深入介绍一下这些课程。

sentences.en: So, like I said, they're in line with the five ways and those five ways are connect, take notice, give back, get active and learn something new.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，它们符合“福祉五法”，这五种方法是：联系、留意、回馈、活跃和学习新事物。

sentences.en: So, putting that into a nature context, you know, there's activities that we can run in line with those approaches.
sentences.zh: 所以，将其置于自然背景下，你知道，我们可以开展符合这些方法的活动。

sentences.en: So macro photography, volunteering, so things like tree planting, for example,
sentences.zh: 比如微距摄影、志愿服务，例如植树，

sentences.en: going for a long walk and running some mindfulness activities, which have all been really impactful ways for people to connect with nature and with the people around them as well.
sentences.zh: 进行长途步行并开展一些正念活动，这些对人们与自然以及周围的人建立联系来说，都是非常有影响力的途径。

sentences.en: And then other things that we run within the health and wellbeing team
sentences.zh: 我们在健康与福祉团队内开展的其他活动

sentences.en: are bushcraft activities.
sentences.zh: 还有丛林生存技能活动。

sentences.en: So a bit more hands-on, practical, fire lighting activities.
sentences.zh: 更具实践性，比如生火活动。

sentences.en: So sort of bring out sort of like you're in a kid in a way when you might go into the woods and do a variety of different things.
sentences.zh: 这有点像让你回到童年，当你走进树林做各种各样的事情时。

sentences.en: And then also we run volunteering activities, which we do as an organisation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还开展志愿服务活动，这是我们作为一个组织所做的。

sentences.en: We offer those across the board, actually, in our organisation.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们在整个组织范围内都提供这些机会。

sentences.en: So we have 65 nature reserves.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有 65 个自然保护区。

sentences.en: And within those volunteers that we have, about 700, they're the lifeblood of our organisation.
sentences.zh: 在我们的志愿者中，大约有 700 人，他们是我们组织的命脉。

sentences.en: For us to be managing those sites to support wildlife.
sentences.zh: 帮助我们管理这些场地以支持野生动物。

sentences.en: So we run volunteering activities for people that experience poor ill health that may have been signposted by their GPs,
sentences.zh: 我们为那些经历健康状况不佳、可能由全科医生转介的人开展志愿服务活动，

sentences.en: along with other social prescribers as well.
sentences.zh: 以及其他社会处方员转介的人。

sentences.en: And then they can get out onto our nature reserves with one of our project offices and get stuck in and use nature in a sort of green prescribing way, if you like.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可以和我们的项目官员一起去我们的自然保护区，亲身参与其中，以一种“绿色处方”的方式利用自然。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And that's really powerful.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有力量。

sentences.en: And I think it's like you said, it's the mindfulness aspect of it.
sentences.zh: 我想就像你说的，这是其中的正念方面。

sentences.en: But also, people can feel a bit apprehensive about doing things that are new, but it sounds like that doesn't need to be the case when you're going to these wildlife centres,
sentences.zh: 但人们在做新事物时可能会感到有些不安，但听起来当你去这些野生动物中心时，情况并非如此，

sentences.en: because there will be people who are really thrilled to talk to you and guide you through what you might be looking at or what you might like to look for.
sentences.zh: 因为会有非常乐意与你交谈并指导你观察你可能正在看的东西，或者你可能想寻找的东西的人。

sentences.en: Yes, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So we do completely recognise that there are some barriers with people accessing nature, whether that be a fear of safety and being out on their own in a woodland, for example,
sentences.zh: 我们完全认识到人们接触自然存在一些障碍，无论是对安全的恐惧，还是比如独自在林地里，

sentences.en: can be daunting for some people.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说可能令人生畏。

sentences.en: And maybe they don't feel that nature's for them
sentences.zh: 也许他们觉得大自然不适合他们，

sentences.en: and it's not relevant to their lives.
sentences.zh: 或者与他们的生活无关。

sentences.en: But as an organisation, we're really keen to
sentences.zh: 但作为一个组织，我们非常渴望

sentences.en: instil a level of nature into people's lives because we know how important and powerful it is to nurture people's mental health.
sentences.zh: 在人们的生活中注入一定程度的自然元素，因为我们知道这对于滋养人们的心理健康是多么重要和强大。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we are as welcoming as we can be.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们尽可能地保持欢迎的态度。

sentences.en: And we do go out into the community quite a lot through our outreach work to inspire and connect the more disengaged audiences in society
sentences.zh: 我们确实通过外展工作深入社区，以激励和联系社会中那些参与度较低的群体，

sentences.en: within Warwickshire, Coventry and Solihull.
sentences.zh: 在沃里克郡、考文垂和索利哈尔地区。

sentences.en: Yeah, and, you know, I've been to your centre with my, specifically with my young children when they were a little bit younger.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我去过你们的中心，特别是带着我年幼的孩子去过，当时他们还小一点。

sentences.en: And what I really like is you've got a cafe there as well.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢你们那里还有一个咖啡馆。

sentences.en: And there's a TV where at the time you could see, like, I think it was Kestrels on the roof of a local building with their little chicks.
sentences.zh: 那里有一台电视，当时你可以看到，我想是当地一栋建筑屋顶上的红隼和它们的小雏鸟。

sentences.en: Was it Kestrels?
sentences.zh: 是红隼吗？

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: So they're peregrines.
sentences.zh: 那是游隼。

sentences.en: So they're in the same family of birds of prey.
sentences.zh: 它们属于同一个猛禽家族。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we have a webcam, which is in a, it's a partnership project with Warwick District Council.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们有一个网络摄像头，这是一个与沃里克区议会的合作项目。

sentences.en: And, yeah, we have a successful pair of nesting peregrines in the town hall in Leamington.
sentences.zh: 是的，在利明顿市政厅有一对成功筑巢的游隼。

sentences.en: So we also have access to the webcam feed.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也可以访问网络摄像头的画面。

sentences.en: And, yes, we play that along with some of the smaller bird box birds like blue tits and great tits and things that we have on our reserves.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们会播放这些画面，还有一些较小的鸟箱里的鸟，比如蓝山雀、大山雀，以及我们在保护区里有的其他鸟类。

sentences.en: And that's such an intimate way to connect with nature, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一种与自然建立亲密联系的方式，不是吗？

sentences.en: Seeing the whole breeding cycle of them raising their chicks to them fledging.
sentences.zh: 看着它们整个繁殖周期，从抚养雏鸟到它们离巢。

sentences.en: It's, yeah, really fantastic, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒，不是吗？

sentences.en: It really was.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it was fascinating stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: And to sit there with my little boy and have our lunch and watch these baby chicks eating their lunch, like, it was really, really nice.
sentences.zh: 和我儿子坐在那里吃午饭，看着这些小雏鸟吃午饭，真的非常非常美好。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: And I guess if, and I think you also had bird tables set up outside the windows to the cafe as well.
sentences.zh: 我想，而且我觉得你们还在咖啡馆窗外设置了喂鸟台。

sentences.en: So even if you're not feeling that confident or if you're not that good kind of mobility-wise about getting out and about, there's ways for you to engage with nature
sentences.zh: 所以即使你感觉没那么自信，或者在行动能力上不太方便外出，也有很多方式让你接触自然，

sentences.en: and see stuff that you might not see in your own house or from your own balcony by going to these centres that might just really kind of lift your soul.
sentences.zh: 通过去这些中心，看到你在自己家里或阳台上可能看不到的东西，这真的能提升你的灵魂。

sentences.en: So I really liked that about the centre, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很喜欢这个中心。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very inviting space.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常吸引人的空间。

sentences.en: And we're trying to make it as inclusive as possible within our means.
sentences.zh: 我们正在尽我们所能使其尽可能具有包容性。

sentences.en: And, yeah, like you said, the cafe is a great space for people that may not be as mobile, but we do have some mobility scooters, but not loads.
sentences.zh: 而且，就像你说的，咖啡馆对于行动不便的人来说是一个很好的空间，我们确实有一些代步车，但数量不多。

sentences.en: So, you know, some people will have to sometimes wait so that we can get that level of access onto the Nature Reserve at Brandon Marsh, which is our headquarters.
sentences.zh: 所以，有些人有时需要等待，这样我们才能让他们进入我们总部所在的布兰登沼泽（Brandon Marsh）自然保护区。

sentences.en: But, yes, if you just want a cup of tea and to look out of the window, we always have the bird feeders full.
sentences.zh: 但如果你只是想喝杯茶，看看窗外，我们的喂鸟器总是装得满满的。

sentences.en: And, yeah, it attracts so much wildlife, not just the birds, actually.
sentences.zh: 而且，它吸引了这么多野生动物，实际上不仅仅是鸟类。

sentences.en: We've had monk jack deer, foxes.
sentences.zh: 我们见过麂、狐狸。

sentences.en: Yeah, a real mix of wildlife.
sentences.zh: 是的，各种各样的野生动物。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: My little boy told me that I had to ask you, he's six and a half, I had to ask you about certain wildlife, whether you have it or you don't have it.
sentences.zh: 我儿子让我问你，他六岁半了，让我问你关于某些野生动物的问题，问你们那里有没有。

sentences.en: And I was like, hmm, I think some of these he definitely won't have.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，嗯，我想其中一些你们肯定没有。

sentences.en: A flamingo.
sentences.zh: 火烈鸟。

sentences.en: OK, so that's a definite no, but it would be great.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那肯定是没有，但如果有的话会很棒。

sentences.en: OK, yes.
sentences.zh: 好的，是的。

sentences.en: He asked about foxes and you've said yes to foxes.
sentences.zh: 他问到了狐狸，你说有狐狸。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Badgers.
sentences.zh: 獾。

sentences.en: Badgers.
sentences.zh: 獾。

sentences.en: Yes, most likely we do.
sentences.zh: 是的，很有可能我们有。

sentences.en: I'm not aware of any badger sets, so that's the network of underground tunnels where they live.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有任何獾洞，也就是它们居住的地下隧道网络。

sentences.en: I'm not aware of any that are active, but I wouldn't be surprised if badgers use our nature reserve, even if they don't live there, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有任何活跃的洞穴，但如果獾使用我们的自然保护区，即使它们不住在那里，我也不会感到惊讶，这说得通吧。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And I know moles are not always people's friends, especially like farmers.
